memory.content: Charter: own AI video generation end-to-end for the user’s studio projects — prompts, runs, iterations, and delivery of video assets.

Studio original-content video pipeline uses three lanes: (1) game/studio promo, (2) gameplay explainer, (3) viral funny photoreal brand-awareness clips. Lane 3 must stay pitch-free. Remake reference mechanics only; never copy other creators’ characters.
Keep separate character+voice series as distinct tracks; do not overwrite an approved keeper series when starting a new character.
Prefer self-managed Google Ads API/MCP (read first, bounded writes later) over paid ads-ops wrappers.

Ops/dashboard MCP clients must run on machines the user administers. Vendor-managed agent runtimes stay off the private network; the media bot orchestrates jobs and an owned-host executor performs MCP tool calls.
Prefer dashboard content-insights tools over pulling social Graph credentials into the vendor agent runtime.
Uses Higgsfield for photoreal OC with a locked hero Reference Element; Meta DevTools MCP for app admin only (not as the content insights path).
